MATH 3A.description: Differential calculus covers functions, limits, differentiation and applications, elementary integration, and logarithmic and trigonometric functions.

MATH 3B.description: Integral calculus covers integration methods, sequences and series, with mathematical and physical applications.

MATH 4A.description: Linear algebra covers equations, matrices, vector spaces, linear transformations, eigenvalues, diagonalization and orthogonality.

MATH 4B.description: Differential equations include first- and second-order equations, systems, nonlinear behavior and stability.

MATH 6A.description: Multivariable calculus covers vector-valued functions, derivatives, multiple integrals, applications and coordinate changes.
